desc: Build an adjacency list representation of the graph from the M constraints.
Implement a BFS/DFS traversal to identify connected components and check for consistency (contradictions in XOR values). If a contradiction is found, return -1.
For each connected component, calculate the relative values $R_i$ for all nodes in the component based on the root being 0.

For each component, determine the optimal constant $C$ by iterating over each bit position (0 to 29) and choosing the bit that minimizes the sum of that bit's contribution across all nodes in the component.
Compute the final values $A_i = R_i \oplus C_{component(i)}$ for all nodes and print the sequence.
